Behavior
- In `verifyGitReference`, a declaration whose canonical `repositoryRoot` or exact Git `path` is changed by credential scanning must fail with `reference-failed` before the verified artifact is returned to `admitDeclarations`.
- Clean references continue to admit normally. Successful artifacts preserve the exact canonical repository root and declared path; scanning may contribute a clean report but must never supply replacement identity coordinates.
- The recorder remains pre-spawn and non-promoting on this failure; no session inspection is involved.

Owner
- Put the invariant in the existing Git-reference admission seam, `src/recorder/admit.ts::verifyGitReference`, immediately after scanning `repositoryRoot` and `path` and before constructing/returning `AdmittedArtifact`. This seam owns both exact Git verification and creation of `ReferenceIdentity`; do not add a parallel config/manifest mechanism.
- Rebuild the checked-in recorder output so `dist/recorder/admit.js` matches source.

Red
- Add one end-to-end regression in `test/recorder-admission.test.ts` using an otherwise valid committed reference whose repository directory coordinate contains a scanner-recognized credential shape (for example a `token=...` path component). At current HEAD it reaches admission, scanning rewrites `repositoryRoot`, and the child counter proves the bug by incrementing / allowing promotion.
- The regression must assert recorder exit 125, child count unchanged, no final docket, and unchanged archive Git state. Include an ordinary clean-coordinate control in the same test proving one spawn and successful promotion, so failure cannot be attributed to malformed Git coordinates or fixture setup.

Green
- After both scans, compare scanned values with the exact verified originals (and/or redaction flags) and throw `RecorderError("reference-failed", ...)` on any identity mutation. Return the original `repositoryRoot` and `ref.path`, with `redactionStatus: "clean"`; do not return `[REDACTED]` or synthesize alternate coordinates.
- Run focused: `node --import tsx --test test/recorder-admission.test.ts`.
- Run `npm run typecheck`.
- Run full: `npm test` (and `npm run build:recorder` to regenerate/check distributable recorder output), then confirm only the authorized source, focused regression, and generated dist file changed.

Scope
- Limit changes to `src/recorder/admit.ts`, `test/recorder-admission.test.ts`, and generated `dist/recorder/admit.js`; no schema, README, Soul, session, scanner-rule, config, manifest, or acceptance weakening changes.
- Apply phase creates exactly one forward commit from the then-starting HEAD, proposed title `fix(recorder): fail closed on Git reference identity scans`, and reports the commit plus focused/typecheck/full/build evidence in the Fixer Receipt.
